It's Your Burn (for real)

Help define the future of Wicked Maine Arts Society

Wicked Maine Arts Society (WMAS) is the org that runs the burn you are at. We want the give the community the opportunity to own and steer the future of this org and we need your help to figure out how that will look.

If you are interested in helping define WMAS's future and/or bylaws or want to stay in the loop please add your info below and you will hear from us in the coming months.
